O1.reason: Three uniform GF2 constructors were built, but none yields a target-cheap arbitrary-native checkpoint executor.

O2.reason: No surviving carrier is integrated through arbitrary checkpoint loading, prefill, decode, attention/MLP, KV/cache and sampling.

O3.reason: GF2 exactness and encoded-state algebra were established only for the declared controls; arbitrary native ordered Q4/BF16/FP32 logits/KV/RNG successor correspondence is absent.

O4.reason: Explicit routing descriptors, Patricia edge programs, or transformed nonlinear work make every current candidate adverse; no surviving whole-model upper bound exists.

O5.reason: 405B, CUDA, <=8 GiB physical GPU, PCIe/SSD/HBM, native4BQ4 p50/p95 and TTFT were not executed.

O6.reason: Preregistration, executable algorithms, focused tests, JSON/checksum and reports are inspectable; whole theory remains incomplete.

established_scoped_results: An exact arbitrary-GF2 alias router can move checkpoint selectors entirely into an address relation and reduce the favorable square query-table plus row-XOR arithmetic to about 5.31% of leaf+add slots.
That alias relation losslessly carries the checkpoint; the explicit 64-bit-descriptor registered realization is about 300.75 GiB and cannot fit in the 8 GiB hot grant.
An exact arbitrary-GF2 Patricia pattern synthesizer can reduce favorable edge-plus-leaf event count to about 2.34% on the square control.
With the preregistered one-64-bit-label-per-edge representation, Patricia edge labels alone are about 1.99988x the binary source before topology/membership metadata.
Every arbitrary GF2 rectangular matrix has a finite rank-normal A W B = J compiler verified on controls.

Per-operator rank-normalization can reduce an isolated full-rank square map to 1/n effects, but the explicitly conjugated AND micrograph restores both dense maps and costs about 1.00003x the original graph in the frozen scalar-slot ledger.

per-operator rank-normal encoding with the literal factorized transformed Hadamard
still_open: general nonlinear implicit program/address source with target-cheap physical metadata
succinct exact query-time program synthesis outside the Patricia realization
